rows.22:96ec:
That voice itself seemed like a ghost's, and it scared me so much.
I raced desperately up the stairs, and at long last I made it to the floor where the exam rooms were.{p}
rows.22:9c38:
The exam was finally over, and it was break time.
Lunch break came after third period, so I hurried through my lunch and then went to check that restroom.
Sure, I was really scared.
If it weren't for Nakano, I'd never have wanted to go near that place again.
But even if I'd only just met him, a guy I'd been talking with had gone through something like that.
And on top of that, he hadn't even shown up for the exam.{p}
rows.22:9f50:
I couldn't sense any ghostly aura from it at all.
It looked like a perfectly ordinary restroom.
I worked up my nerve and decided to go inside and look for Nakano.
I stepped in, but no invisible hands grabbed me like before.
I mean, there are only so many places to look in a restroom, right?
Unless someone's hiding in a stall or in the cleaning closet, you can see the whole place from the entrance.
I went around peeking into the stalls, one by one.
And finally, it was time to look in the last stall.
It was the one closest to the hallway, a dark, damp stall.{p}
rows.22:a178:
It gave me the creeps, but when I peeked in, something was lying beside the toilet.
I went over and picked it up: it was a button off a school uniform.
I couldn't tell which school it was from, but at least I could tell it wasn't from this high school.
"Ah!"
In a flash, it came to me.
That it might be a button that had fallen off Nakano's uniform.
There was nothing to back that up, but I was sure this had to be Nakano's button.
"Nakano..."
The moment I murmured that...{p}
rows.22:a5d4:
There was no telling when those hands from before would come out.
Sobbing and screaming, I kept pounding on the door with my fists.
Even so, nobody came, and the door didn't open.
While I was doing that, I felt like I could hear something mixed in with the pounding.
I stopped pounding on the door and listened closely.
...I couldn't hear a thing.
But even though my ears couldn't hear it, I was sure I could hear something.
It felt like it was coming from the door.
I got scared to be near the door, so I pressed myself against the back wall to get as far from it as I could, and stared at the door.
And then I noticed something.
You know how restroom doors often have graffiti on them, right?
Dirty drawings, or
"Love you, So-and-so! From Such-and-such, Class 2-B"
and messages like that.
At first I figured it was more of that and didn't pay it any mind, but then I noticed one piece of graffiti that said something different.
I thought it was written in pencil, but when I looked closely, it looked like it had been scratched in with a fingernail or something.
This is what the graffiti said.{p}
rows.22:b528:
(That's it, I'll go get a teacher.)
That's what I thought, so I ran off to find one.
I knew bringing a teacher wouldn't really solve anything, but I figured it was better than going in to help all by myself.
Part of it was that I was scared to go into that restroom alone again, too...
rows.22:bd08:
When I looked closer, it seemed Nakano was being tickled too.
He must have laughed so hard he couldn't breathe.
"Nakano! Nakano!"
I called his name, but there was no response at all.
{a}{f:|}, just imagine it.
Being tickled by invisible hands.
I could never stand that.
Even if you try to escape, dozens of hands hold you down, and you can't move.
And in that state, they tickle you.
Rather than have that done to you, you'd start thinking how much happier you'd be if they just killed you in one go.
After writhing and staggering around for a while, the teacher collapsed onto the floor.
Nakano was convulsing, foaming at the mouth, snot running from his nose.
I couldn't bear the sight anymore, and I ran away.{p}
rows.22:c08c:
...The next thing I knew, I was shaking at a desk in the classroom.
I had no memory at all of how I'd gotten back there.
My legs were trembling, and I was breaking out in a greasy sweat.
Apparently I looked pretty awful at the time.
I mean, a total stranger, another examinee sitting nearby, got worried and spoke to me.
I thought about what to do.
I knew I had to tell someone and call for help.
But when I thought I might get dragged in by the invisible hands again like before, I couldn't tell anyone.
rows.22:c638:
I did think about it, but that was the one thing I just couldn't do.
Those invisible hands might still be crowding around in there...
"It's fine. Nakano must have gotten away, I'm sure of it.
Then he got scared and went home.
I kind of want to blow off the exams and go home myself.
Yeah, that has to be it."{p}
rows.22:c84c:
"N-Nakano!"
That's right, standing there was Nakano, who had changed into blue clothes.
"That was awful of you, Hosoda.
Leaving me behind all alone."
He seemed genuinely angry.
"Where have you been all this time?
I was looking for you."
When I asked him that, he glanced around and told me in a low voice.
"Actually, back then I got so scared I wet myself.
I'm only telling you because I trust you.
Don't tell anyone, okay?
So I talked to a teacher, borrowed a change of clothes, and took the exam in the conference room.
There wasn't time to get to the exam room, so I got special permission.
Once time's up, you can't get into the classroom."
"So that's what happened..."
I suddenly felt terrible, and I apologized to Nakano.
"I'm sorry.
I was panicking too back then, and I couldn't spare a thought for helping you.
I'm really sorry."
"Well, it's fine.
But in exchange, I want you to come with me for a bit once all the exams are over."
That's what Nakano said.
I felt really bad too, so I just said sure, without a second thought.
Looking back now, I wish I hadn't agreed so easily.{p}
rows.22:d634:
Wondering what he'd left behind, I searched under the sinks and around the urinals.
But thinking back, I had a feeling that Nakano hadn't been carrying anything when we first came to this restroom.
No matter how hard I tried to remember, I felt sure he'd had nothing with him.
(What on earth did he leave behind...?)
As I was thinking that, Nakano called out.
"Found it. I found it, Hosoda."
He said it in a voice that didn't sound very happy.
When I turned around, Nakano was standing at the door of a stall, looking inside.
"That's great, Nakano.
Let's hurry up and take it home.
We'd better get out of this creepy place fast."
I was worried those hands might come out again at any moment, so I wanted to get out of there quickly.
Nakano was staring intently into the toilet...
"What's wrong?"
I called to Nakano and looked into the stall over his shoulder as he stood at the door.{p}
